newsitem.title: USA: ValueVision completes sale of TV station.
newsitem.headline: ValueVision completes sale of TV station.

text.p: ValueVision International Inc said Friday completed the sale of its WVVI TV-66 television station serving the Washington, D.C. market, to Paxson Communications Corp.

The station was sold to Paxson for $30 million in cash and 1,197,892 shares of Paxson Communications common stock. Paxson Communications is the nation's largest owner and operator of broadcast television stations.
ValueVision is an electronic and print media direct marketing company and the nation's third-largest television home-shopping network.

"This has been an outstanding transaction for ValueVision as it will provide us with additional capital to further strengthen our balance sheet and continue developing our integrated electronic and print media direct marketing operations," Robert Johander, ValueVision's chairman, said in a statement.
